campuses.title: Main Campus — West Hartford
campuses.text: Главный 350-акровый кампус через Hartford, West Hartford и Bloomfield — Park River пересекает территорию. 7 школ и колледжей в одном месте.

paragraphs: The University of Hartford is a private university chartered in 1957 through the merger of three founding institutions: Hartford Art School, Hillyer College, and The Hartt School. The 350-acre main campus extends across Hartford, West Hartford, and Bloomfield, Connecticut, with a branch of the Park River winding through it, two hours from both Boston and New York City.

UHart organises study across seven schools and colleges: Hartford Art School, Barney School of Business, College of Arts and Sciences, College of Education, Nursing and Health Professions, College of Engineering, Technology, and Architecture, Hillyer College, and The Hartt School. Together they deliver 100+ undergraduate programmes and 60+ graduate degrees, with strong reputations in music, performing arts, engineering, business, and health professions.

International students from over 50 countries make up roughly 500 of the ~6,000-strong student body. The English Language Institute and the International Pathway Program (IPP) provide language support and conditional-admission routes for applicants who need additional English preparation before degree study.

UHart holds 2024-2025 Colleges of Distinction recognition for graduation rates, career readiness, and hands-on learning. STEM-designated programmes give F-1 international graduates eligibility for the 24-month OPT extension, and the 11:1 student-to-faculty ratio supports close mentorship across all seven schools.
paragraphsRu: University of Hartford — частный университет, учреждён в 1957 году путём слияния трёх институций: Hartford Art School, Hillyer College и The Hartt School. Главный 350-акровый кампус расположен в Hartford, West Hartford и Bloomfield (штат Коннектикут), через территорию протекает рукав реки Park River. Boston и New York City — в двух часах езды.

UHart объединяет 7 школ и колледжей: Hartford Art School, Barney School of Business, College of Arts and Sciences, College of Education, Nursing and Health Professions, College of Engineering, Technology, and Architecture, Hillyer College и The Hartt School. Вместе они предлагают 100+ программ бакалавриата и 60+ магистерских направлений с сильной репутацией в music, performing arts, engineering, business и health professions.

Международные студенты из более чем 50 стран — около 500 человек в общем составе ~6 000 студентов. English Language Institute и International Pathway Program (IPP) дают языковую подготовку и conditional-admission для абитуриентов, которым нужен дополнительный английский перед поступлением на degree-программы.

UHart имеет статус Colleges of Distinction 2024-2025 за высокие показатели выпуска, готовность к карьере и hands-on обучение. STEM-программы дают международным выпускникам право на 24-месячное продление OPT. Соотношение студентов к преподавателям 11:1 обеспечивает индивидуальное наставничество во всех семи школах.

350-acre campus across Hartford, West Hartford, and Bloomfield, CT
7 schools and colleges — 100+ undergraduate + 60+ graduate programmes
STEM-designated programmes — 24-month OPT eligibility for F-1 grads
Two hours from Boston and New York City
